The *Ekamaggakathā* ("Discussion on One Path", Kv 18.5) is a short debate situated within the eighteenth chapter (*pannāsaka* / *vagga*) of the *Kathāvatthu*, the fifth treatise of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records one modern translation in one language, with no curated cross-canonical parallels registered [SuttaCentral].

Its closest internal alignments occur within other sections of the *Kathāvatthu*, most notably with the *Sabbasaṁyojanappahānakathā* (Kv 4.10), with which it shares extensive phrasing between §2.3–4.8 and §2.1–7.6, as well as the *Jahatikathā* (Kv 1.5), *Aparāpisamannāgatakathā* (Kv 4.9), *Samannāgatakathā* (Kv 4.4), and the *Vimokkhakathā* of the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* (Ps 1.5) [DharmaNexus].
